config.purpose: Matched extra-training control. Same initial checkpoint and reset AdamW as physics branch. Select by validation data MSE; test locked.

timing_warning: synchronized isolated latency, not end-to-end or native 128^3 certification
metrics_warning: Whole-grid including solids; pressure channel RMSE uses gauge-centered targets, not raw absolute pressure. Resolution 64^3; Endpoint-aligned uniform64 cache; no physics acceptance.
pressure_target_convention: Per-sample mean pressure removed only on SDF>0 points; solid pressure set to zero. Each validation target uses its own mean, no train/test statistics.
physics_penalty_convention: central FD unit-cube coordinates, all-fluid stencil; predicted divergence MSE / max(reference divergence MSE, configured floor); not full Navier-Stokes residual
model_selection: minimum validation standardized whole-grid MSE, fixed before this run
